three.js — three 0.170.0 (https://github.com/mrdoob/three.js), MIT.

Vendored byte-for-byte from the npm package "three@0.170.0":
  build/three.module.min.js  -> three.module.min.js

  sha256  08fd7545d13d2c7fb65ab691530a802dafefd638596501854f267d0fb13c39e7

This is the package's own self-contained minified ES-module browser build, copied
unmodified. (The r171+ builds split this file into a thin wrapper plus
build/three.core.min.js; r170 is the last single-file release, so a lone
three.module.min.js loads with no further fetch.) Exposed to `html` and `react`
artifacts through the `three` import-map specifier in shell.js, SRI-pinned there
(sha512 of these exact bytes). The examples/ addons (jsm/) are NOT vendored.
